observations: 14 check tu 8 capability + 3 unknown_areas cua FEAT-04. Day la feature co risk nghiem trong nhat trong toan bo object: KB-034 (mutation Width='abc' tra 200 kem loi Postgres tho) va KB-047 (pham vi Hasura _set chua verify) duoc giu nguyen priority P1 theo yeu cau cua nguoi dieu phoi, du oracle cua ca hai chi la BASELINE/NONE (chua co nguon CONFIRMED_EXPECTED nao xac nhan day la bug can fix hay hanh vi chap nhan duoc).

KB-047 duoc tach thanh 2 check rieng: 1 check BASELINE mo ta co che ghi quan sat duoc (client-side Hasura _set), va 1 check NEGATIVE/NEEDS_CONFIRMATION rieng cho phan chua verify (pham vi cot/hang duoc phep _set) - tranh gan oracle BASELINE cho phan chua co evidence.

checks.title: RUI RO P1: Nhap gia tri chu ('abc') vao o Width roi confirm - mutation tra HTTP 200 kem loi Postgres tho trong body, UI im lang hoan toan

steps: Bam vao o Width cua 1 printarea
Xoa gia tri, nhap 'abc'
Bam confirm
Quan sat response cua request update_printareas (HTTP status + body)
Quan sat UI: gia tri hien thi, co toast/inline error nao khong
Lap lai 1 lan nua de xac nhan tinh on dinh
checks.observation_point: HTTP status + body cua response update_printareas; gia tri Width hien thi tren UI; su hien dien cua toast/inline error
checks.expected_result: BASELINE hien tai (OBSERVED_CURRENT, KB-034, da lap lai 2/2 lan): response HTTP 200 kem body {errors:[{extensions:{code:'data-exception'}, message:'invalid input syntax for type integer: "abc"'}]}; UI KHONG doi gia tri hien thi, KHONG toast, KHONG inline error - loi chi co trong console/network, lo engine (Postgres) va kieu cot (integer) cho user dang nhap. Day KHONG phai la hanh vi da duoc CONFIRMED_EXPECTED - chi la baseline hien tai. Neu ket qua LECH khoi baseline nay (vd UI bat dau bao loi, hoac response khong con lo chi tiet Postgres) can dieu tra de xac dinh la fix co chu dich hay side-effect khac, khong duoc tu ket luan la regression neu chua ro nguyen nhan
